arxiv-2102-01088.title: VVV CL001: Likely the Most Metal-Poor Surviving Globular Cluster in the Inner Galaxy
arxiv-2102-01088.creator: José G. Fernández-Trincado, Dante Minniti, Stefano O. Souza, Timothy C. Beers, Doug Geisler, Christian Moni Bidin, Sandro Villanova, Steven R. Majewski, Beatriz Barbuy, Angeles Pérez-Villegas, Lady Henao, María Romero-Colmenares, Alexandre Roman-Lopes, Richard R. Lane
arxiv-2102-01088.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by José G. Fernández-Trincado, Dante Minniti, Stefano O. Souza, Timothy C. Beers, Doug Geisler, Christian Moni Bidin, Sandro Villanova, Steven R. Majewski, Beatriz Barbuy, Angeles Pérez-Villegas, Lady Henao, María Romero-Colmenares, Alexandre Roman-Lopes, Richard R. Lane. We present the first high-resolution abundance analysis of the globular cluster VVV CL001, which resides in a region dominated by high interstellar reddening towards the Galactic Bulge.

arxiv-2104-12561.title: Artificial Intelligence Based Prognostic Maintenance of Renewable Energy Systems: A Review of Techniques, Challenges, and Future Research Directions
arxiv-2104-12561.creator: Yasir Saleem Afridi 1 , Kashif Ahmad 2 , Laiq Hassan 1
arxiv-2104-12561.description: Abstract Since the depletion of fossil fuels, the world has started to rely heavily on renewable sources of energy. With every passing year, our dependency on the renewable sources of energy is increasing exponentially. As a result, complex and hybrid generation systems are being designed and developed to meet the energy demands and ensure energy security in a country.

arxiv-2106-07459.title: Piercing All Translates of a Set of Axis-Parallel Rectangles A preliminary version appears in Proceedings of IWOCA 2021.
arxiv-2106-07459.creator: Adrian Dumitrescu, Josef Tkadlec
arxiv-2106-07459.description: Abstract For a given shape S S in the plane, one can ask what is the lowest possible density of a point set P P that pierces (“intersects”, “hits”) all translates of S S . This is equivalent to determining the covering density of S S and as such is well studied.

arxiv-2108-01510.title: MCEM and SAEM Algorithms for Geostatistical Models under Preferential Sampling
arxiv-2108-01510.description: Abstract The problem of preferential sampling in geostatistics arises when the choise of location to be sampled is made with information about the phenomena in the study. The geostatistical model under preferential sampling deals with this problem, but parameter estimation is challenging because the likelihood function has no closed form.

arxiv-2204-03410.title: Incremental Prototype Tuning for Class Incremental Learning
arxiv-2204-03410.creator: Jieren Deng, Haojian Zhang, Jianhua Hu, Yunkuan Wang
arxiv-2204-03410.description: Abstract Class incremental learning(CIL) has attracted much attention, but most existing related works focus on fine-tuning the entire representation model, which inevitably results in much catastrophic forgetting. In the contrast, with a semantic-rich pre-trained representation model, parameter-additional-tuning (PAT) only changes very few parameters to learn new visual concepts.

arxiv-2207-14246.title: FleetPy: A Modular Open-Source Simulation Tool for Mobility On-Demand Services
arxiv-2207-14246.creator: Roman Engelhardt, Florian Dandl, Arslan-Ali Syed
arxiv-2207-14246.description: Abstract The market share of mobility on-demand (MoD) services strongly increased in recent years and is expected to rise even higher once vehicle automation is fully available. These services might reduce space consumption in cities as fewer parking spaces are required if private vehicle trips are replaced. If rides are shared additionally, occupancy related traffic efficiency is increased.

arxiv-2210-05411.title: Class-Specific Explainability for Deep Time Series Classifiers
arxiv-2210-05411.creator: Ramesh Doddaiah §, Prathyush Parvatharaju §, Elke Rundensteiner, Thomas Hartvigsen
arxiv-2210-05411.description: Abstract Explainability helps users trust deep learning solutions for time series classification. However, existing explainability methods for multi-class time series classifiers focus on one class at a time, ignoring relationships between the classes. Instead, when a classifier is choosing between many classes, an effective explanation must show what sets the chosen class apart from the rest.

arxiv-2305-01683.title: Timescales of Chaos in the Inner Solar System: Lyapunov Spectrum and Quasi-integrals of Motion
arxiv-2305-01683.creator: Federico Mogavero, Nam H. Hoang, Jacques Laskar
arxiv-2305-01683.description: Abstract Numerical integrations of the Solar System reveal a remarkable stability of the orbits of the inner planets over billions of years, in spite of their chaotic variations characterized by a Lyapunov time of only 5 million years and the lack of integrals of motion able to constrain their dynamics.

arxiv-2406-13851.title: Optimizing Quantile-based Trading Strategies in Electricity Arbitrage
arxiv-2406-13851.creator: Ciaran O’Connor, Joseph Collins, Steven Prestwich, Andrea Visentin
arxiv-2406-13851.description: Abstract Efficiently integrating renewable resources into electricity markets is vital for addressing the challenges of matching real-time supply and demand while reducing the significant energy wastage resulting from curtailments. To address this challenge effectively, the incorporation of storage devices can enhance the reliability and efficiency of the grid, improving market liquidity and reducing price volatility.

As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) become increasingly integrated into user-facing applications, they are often deployed in split DNN configurations, where the visual encoder (e.g., ResNet or ViT) runs on user-side devices and only intermediate features are transmitted to the cloud for downstream processing.

arxiv-2602-14588.creator: Alexander Freiszlinger, Dirk Pauly, Dirk Praetorius, Michael Schomburg
arxiv-2602-14588.description: Abstract . In the present work, we derive functional upper bounds for the potential error arising from finite-element boundary-element coupling formulations for a nonlinear Poisson-type transmission problem. The proposed a posteriori error estimates are independent of the precise discretization scheme and provide guaranteed upper bounds for the potential error.

pmc-11317013.title: Danggui Shaoyao San and disassembled prescription: neuroprotective effects via AMPK/mTOR-mediated autophagy in mice
pmc-11317013.creator: Xiaoqing Cheng, Yuqiong Dai, Baoling Shang, Shuting Zhang, Liting Lin, Qingguang Wu, Ruoting Zhan, Shengqing Li, Sijun Liu
pmc-11317013.description: BackgroundDanggui Shaoyao San (DSS), a frequently prescribed Chinese medicine formula, has demonstrated clinical efficacy in the treatment of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). This study aims to explore the differences in therapeutic effects of DSS and its disassembled prescriptions, Suangan (SG) and Xingan (XG), in treating Alzheimer’s Disease and the mechanism of DSS recovering autophagy in AD.

pmc-11348725.title: Potential mechanisms of gut microbiota influence on different types of vertigo: a bidirectional Mendelian randomization and mediation analysis
pmc-11348725.creator: Qiongwen Rong, Hao Chen, Yibin Chen, Minghui Xu, Ruixue Chen, Changxuan Li
pmc-11348725.description: BackgroundThe relationship between gut microbiota and vertigo, specifically Benign Paroxysmal Vertigo (BPV) and Vertigo of Central (VC), remains underexplored.Aim and hypothesesThis study aims to investigate the causal relationships between gut microbiota and two types of vertigo, BPV and VC. Additionally, the study seeks to explore the mediation effects of metabolic, inflammatory, and psychological factors on these relationships.

pmc-11438631.title: Emerging lasers and light-based therapies in the management of acne: a review
pmc-11438631.creator: Philippe Jean-Pierre, Lea Tordjman, Arjun Ghodasara, Chika Nwosu, Keyvan Nouri
pmc-11438631.description: Acne vulgaris, commonly known as acne, is the most prevalent skin disorder affecting mainly adolescents and young adults, though it can affect people of all ages, making it the most common complaint by patients presenting to a dermatologist. The overactivity of sebaceous glands primarily drives this skin condition due to androgen influence and the presence of Cutibacterium acnes bacteria.

pmc-12632261.title: Compositional analysis of bacterial peptidoglycan: insights from peptidoglycomics into structure and function
pmc-12632261.creator: Erin M. Anderson, Dyanne Brewer, Matthew T. Sorbara, Cezar M. Khursigara
pmc-12632261.description: Peptidoglycan (PG) is a critical component of bacterial cell walls that stabilizes the cell membrane while performing diverse physiological roles. It consists of a polysaccharide backbone cross-linked by peptide side chains forming a lattice-like sacculus that encases the entire cell.

pmc-13127692.title: Lipomatous Variant of Solitary Fibrous Tumor With CD34 Negativity: A Case Report
pmc-13127692.creator: Mohammed Bakhti, Anass Haloui, Nassira Karich, Amal Bennani
pmc-13127692.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The solitary fibrous tumor (SFT) in its lipomatous variant is very rare, with only a few cases described in the literature. It is a myofibroblastic mesenchymal tumor with intermediate behavior. We report the case of a 33-year-old patient with no notable pathological history, admitted following the incidental discovery of a dorsal mass involving the soft tissues, whose radiological examination suggested a schwannoma. The patient underwent a surgical biopsy showing a tumoral proliferation composed of spindle cells within mature adipose tissue.

pmc-13157673.title: Techno-uncertainty and organizational counterproductive work behavior among Generation X employees in a South African state-owned enterprise: the moderating role of gender
pmc-13157673.creator: Crispen Chipunza, Lovemore T. Chipunza, Samson Adewumi
pmc-13157673.description: The increasing adoption of digital technologies in organizations continues to raise concerns about their impact on employee behavior. Although prior studies have examined technostress as a composite construct, limited attention has been given to how its individual dimensions influence negative workplace behaviors across different demographic groups.

pmc-13194250.title: Detection of bilirubin by stripping voltammetry at the gelled anisole – aqueous electrified interface supported with a 3D printed pore
pmc-13194250.creator: Karolina Marciniak, Konrad Rudnicki, Karolina Kowalewska, Grzegorz Kowalski, Michal Poltorak, Irena Walecka, Grégoire Herzog, Lukasz Poltorak
pmc-13194250.description: A method is reported for the detection of bilirubin its anionic form (BIL2−) by stripping voltammetry at the electrified liquid-liquid interface. In this respect, we have used the aqueous || anisole and aqueous || anisole-PVC gel-based interface as an electroanalytical platform to study interfacial ion transfer reactions of model ion (TPrA+) and BIL2−.

pmc-13385809.title: Dual-domain metamaterials co-integrated with a compact ultrasonic transducer for highly directional audio generation
pmc-13385809.creator: Woongji Kim, Beomseok Oh, Wonkyu Moon, Junsuk Rho
pmc-13385809.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Directional audio systems, enabling personal sound sweet spots and spatially selective audio delivery, typically rely on parametric acoustic arrays that leverage nonlinear interactions of ultrasound beams to overcome the directivity constraint dictated by the wavenumber-aperture product. Such systems, known as parametric array loudspeakers (PALs), traditionally require phased arrays comprising tens to hundreds of ultrasonic emitters—posing persistent challenges for widespread adoption due to high cost, system complexity, and limited design flexibility.

pmc-13457432.title: Crowe severity and femoral stem geometry are associated with lower-limb alignment after total hip arthroplasty for unilateral developmental dysplasia of the hip–related secondary osteoarthritis: valgus alignment trajectories
pmc-13457432.creator: Muhammed Yusuf Afacan, Mahmut Gorkem Gurcinar, Cumhur Deniz Davulcu, Mehmet Can Unlu, Gokhan Kaynak
pmc-13457432.description: BackgroundTotal hip arthroplasty (THA) for secondary osteoarthritis related to developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) restores hip mechanics. We aimed to quantify pre-to-postoperative changes in ipsilateral knee and global lower-limb alignment after unilateral THA to determine whether alignment changes differ by Crowe classification and femoral stem geometry.

pmc-13478228.title: A metabolite-bridged complex between SerRS and SIRT2 couples NAD⁺ metabolism to translation control
pmc-13478228.creator: Qian Zhang, Huimin Zhang, Marscha Hirschi, Sheng Li, Gabriel C. Lander, Jie Yang, Xiang-Lei Yang
pmc-13478228.description: Cellular homeostasis requires tight coordination between metabolic and translational networks. Here we identify a direct molecular link between these processes through a cryo-EM structure of human cytosolic seryl-tRNA synthetase (SerRS) in complex with the NAD⁺-dependent deacetylase SIRT2. This interaction is promoted by the NAD⁺ metabolite ADP-ribose (ADPR), which acts as a molecular bridge between the two enzymes.
